summary: Firy Inc. (formerly Skillz Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting a partial redemption of $80.0 million aggregate principal of its 10.250% Secured Notes due 2026. The redemption price is 100.000% of principal plus accrued interest, with the redemption date set for August 14, 2026. As of the filing, $129,671,000 in Notes remained outstanding. UMB Bank, N.A. serves as trustee and paying agent. This partial debt redemption reduces outstanding leverage and interest obligations, returning capital to noteholders. Watch for the remaining Notes balance and any future redemptions or refinancing activity.
